description: Sub-national residual fuel consumption is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Energy Security and Net Zero. Statistics on the consumption of residual fuel data broken down by local authority. Residual fuels are fuels not used for electricity generation or road transport, and are defined as non-gas, non-electricity and non-road transport fuels. They include: coal, petroleum, manufactured solid fuels, bioenergy and waste. Accredited Official Statistics. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Energy Security and Net Zero. It offers 9 resource(s) in .XLSX, WEBPAGE. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
